sequence_points.name: Abstract Landscape with Vertical Forms
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring blurred, elongated forms in muted blues, greens, and grays, suggesting a forest or natural scene. The artwork is mounted on a museum wall with a dark frame.

sequence_points.name: Winter Landscape with Snowy Field
sequence_points.description: A landscape painting depicting a snow-covered field with sparse vegetation and distant trees under a pale blue sky. The composition features a horizontal division between the snowy foreground and the horizon line, rendered in muted earth tones and whites.

sequence_points.name: Seascape at Sunset
sequence_points.description: A vertical painting depicting a dramatic sunset over a turbulent sea, with warm orange and pink hues in the sky transitioning to dark blues and blacks in the water. The artwork is mounted on a museum wall with a simple frame.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Blurred Forms
sequence_points.description: A blurred, abstract artwork featuring indistinct shapes and muted tones of blue, gray, and white. The composition appears to be mounted on a wall in a museum setting, with no discernible figures or objects.
